meta.title: Ink Arch | Private tattoo studio by Camden Market
meta.description: Private tattoo studio in a railway arch near Camden Market. Fine line, traditional and blackwork by appointment. Request a free consultation.

rationale: The studio is a railway arch, open after hours, so the page is near-black with one acid lime accent and hard-edged condensed type, like a poster pasted on the brickwork. Each artist gets a photo-led row because the work has to be seen, and the booking path is shown as plain steps and a short conversation for first-timers. The custom drawing is a tattoo machine under the arch.

props.headline: Ink Arch. Under the railway, after hours.

items.name: Mira: fine line and botanicals
items.description: Thin single-needle lines, ferns, wildflowers and stems that follow the shape of an arm or ribcage. Mira draws every design for the person wearing it.

photo.subject: Close-up of a fresh fine line botanical tattoo on a forearm, shot in the studio under warm lamp light, skin clean and in focus

items.name: Jay: traditional
items.description: Bold outlines, solid colour, roses, daggers, swallows and ships. Jay works in the classic style and keeps the designs readable from across a room.

photo.subject: A healed traditional tattoo (rose or swallow) on a shoulder or calf, bold black outline and flat colour, taken in daylight against the arch brickwork

items.name: Sol: blackwork
items.description: Heavy black fills, geometry and large solid shapes. Sol plans blackwork around the body so the shapes sit where the muscle and bone are.

photo.subject: Large blackwork tattoo across a back or thigh, deep solid black with clean edges, side-lit to show the saturation

steps.name: Send your idea
steps.detail: Tell us where on the body, roughly how big, and which artist you have in mind. Pictures help.

steps.name: Free consultation
steps.detail: You talk the design through with the artist before anything is drawn. No charge, no pressure to go ahead.

steps.name: Pay the deposit
steps.detail: The deposit holds your date. It is taken off the price of the tattoo.

steps.name: Session day
steps.detail: You arrive at the arch at your time. Nobody else is waiting, because every slot is booked.

props.after: and a drawing made for you.

items.claim: Single-use needles and tubes, opened in front of you
items.detail: Anything that touches skin is used once and thrown away.

items.claim: Surfaces wiped and covered between every client
items.detail: The station is reset before you sit down.

items.claim: Private studio, one client at a time
items.detail: No crowd in the room, no one passing through while you are being worked on.

props.title: If it is your first tattoo

pairs.ask: I do not know what I want yet.
pairs.answer: Come to the consultation with a few pictures and a rough idea. The artist will tell you what works on your skin and where.
It depends on the place and the style. Your artist will tell you what to expect for your piece before you pay a deposit.
No. We work by appointment only, so request a consultation and we will find a time.
